title: QR code login
subtitle: Scan with your signed-in phone and approve this computer
loopback: This address only works on this computer. Open the site through a domain or LAN address your phone can reach before generating the QR code.
confirmTitle: Allow this computer to sign in?
confirmHint: Only approve a login you started. Check that the numbers match those on your computer.
mobileOnly: Open this page in your phone browser. On a computer, use the QR code on the login page.
cameraHint: Allow camera access and point it at the QR code on your computer's login page.
httpsRequired: This HTTP page cannot access the camera. Use your phone's camera app to scan the computer's QR code, then open it in your browser to approve. Scanning inside this page requires trusted HTTPS.
cameraUnsupported: This browser does not provide camera access. Use your phone's camera app to scan the computer's QR code, then open it in your browser to approve.
browserSessionHint: Each browser keeps its own sign-in state. Use your usual browser and the same site address.
cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in browser settings and use a trusted HTTPS address.
cameraUnavailable: The camera is unavailable. Check whether another app is using it.
invalidCode: Scan the QR code on this site's computer login page

status.idle: Select a tenant and generate a QR code
status.waiting: Waiting for your phone to scan
status.cancelled: Login cancelled. Refresh to try again

result.approved: Approved. Check the login result on your computer
result.cancelled: Cancelled. This computer will not sign in
